guidebook.intro: Proverbs. Elders use them to teach, advise and win arguments.

tips.title: Alemikin na eteteuni inyo?
body: **Alemikin** is a proverb (**alemikineta** proverbs). **Eteteuni** is “it means”: **Alemikin na eteteuni inyo?** (what does this proverb mean?).

tips.title: Some proverbs
body: **Ape ape kitiaŋ ekeny** (one by one the bird builds its nest), **Ekimoit ape mam eyari elat** (one finger can’t kill a louse), **Ŋakiyei ŋulu ejai kiboŋok…** (teeth together…). These are draft translations of the Luganda proverbs.

culture.title: Ekwaŋ elimuni itunga
body: A speaker starts a proverb with **ekwaŋ elimuni itunga** (as people say). Knowing proverbs shows wisdom and respect for elders.
